en: An old sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a broad, mostly empty grassy square bordered by low houses and trees. The buildings look like late 19th- or early 20th‑century wooden or brick town houses. At the top center is the caption 'Lubescher Platz.' At the bottom in decorative script is the phrase 'Gruss aus Walki.' The card is vertically creased and worn, suggesting age.
